findings.issue: main() called unconditionally at module level — when require()'d by registry plugins, CLI scan runs as side effect
findings.recommendation: Guard with if (require.main === module) { main().catch(...) }

findings.issue: parallelConfig.autoSuggest never defined in flow-parallel.js getDefaultConfig() — parallel detection at session startup is dead code
findings.recommendation: Add autoSuggest to getDefaultConfig() or change condition to check parallelConfig.enabled

findings.issue: try-block detection uses 200-char string heuristic producing false positives and negatives
findings.recommendation: Replace with scope-tracking or AST-based check

findings.issue: handleWorktreeRemove() no boundary validation on worktreePath — arbitrary file deletion possible
findings.recommendation: Add resolvedWorktree.startsWith(resolvedProject + path.sep) boundary check

findings.issue: handleWorktreeCreate() validates source but NOT target — state files can be copied to arbitrary locations
findings.recommendation: Add target path boundary validation matching source validation pattern

findings.issue: Dynamic require() of all *-registry.js files without allowlist — supply chain risk
findings.recommendation: Add allowlist of known safe registry filenames

findings.issue: Raw JSON.parse instead of safeJsonParse — prototype pollution risk (also in flow-function-index.js)
findings.recommendation: Replace with safeJsonParse(INDEX_PATH, {})

findings.issue: Raw JSON.parse on settings.json during npm install — prototype pollution
findings.recommendation: Use safeJsonParse or inline prototype-pollution check

findings.issue: Two ComponentScanner classes with same name produce different output files — naming collision
findings.recommendation: Rename Figma-specific one to FigmaComponentScanner

findings.issue: getActiveRegistries() has zero callers — registry system instrumented but not integrated
findings.recommendation: Prioritize wf-manifest-wiring story to wire consumers

findings.issue: Three independent scan paths exist with no coordination — registry, hooks, and CLI
findings.recommendation: Route all scanning through registry manager or document dual-path design

findings.issue: Agent 6 declared MANDATORY but failure mode is soft block — inconsistent
findings.recommendation: Resolve: hard block or change MANDATORY label

findings.issue: Phase 7 references Chrome extension — violates WebMCP decision
findings.recommendation: Update to WebMCP invocation pattern

findings.issue: Plugin scans run sequentially — should use Promise.all
findings.recommendation: Replace sequential loop with Promise.all(this.activePlugins.map(...))

findings.issue: shouldExclude() recompiles RegExp per file per pattern — thousands of redundant allocations
findings.recommendation: Pre-compile in constructor, cache as this._excludeRegexps

findings.issue: Levenshtein allocates full O(N×M) matrix per function pair — quadratic memory
findings.recommendation: Switch to single-row DP + early-exit on length ratio

findings.issue: CLAUDE.md may diverge from template render — missing strictAdherence section
findings.recommendation: Regenerate via flow bridge sync

findings.issue: Missing morningBriefing.showRuleViolations and showAutoPromotedRules config keys
findings.recommendation: Add keys with _comment_ documentation

findings.issue: Missing decide.violationRouting config sub-object documented in wogi-decide.md
findings.recommendation: Add violationRouting with thresholds

findings.issue: Source 2 auto-promoted rules detection depends on session timestamp that has no storage mechanism
findings.recommendation: Store last-briefing timestamp in session-state.json or use flag in decisions.md
